description: The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for different models, including Vanilla and various SepLLM configurations. The x-axis represents TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the Loss Ratio as a percentage on a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot displays five lines: Vanilla (purple, star marker, solid line), which remains steady at 100% across the x-axis; SepLLM (n=64) (orange, dash marker, solid line), which increases from approximately 98.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs to around 100.1% at 3e8 TFLOPs before decreasing to about 99.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs; SepLLM (n=128) (blue, square marker, solid line), which rises from about 97% at 1e7 TFLOPs to around 99.8% at 2e8 TFLOPs and then fluctuates between 99% and 99.8% until 9e8 TFLOPs; SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, diamond marker, solid line), which increases from approximately 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs to around 99.9% at 2e8 TFLOPs before decreasing to about 99.5% at 9e8 TFLOPs; and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, circle marker, solid line), which rises from about 94% at 1e7 TFLOPs to around 98.5% at 3e8 TFLOPs and then decreases to approximately 98.5% at 7e8 TFLOPs before slightly increasing to about 98.7% at 9e8 TFLOPs.
